basic_info.description: Gorgeous Charming Craftsman with a Tranquil Garden in Central Richmond! This beautiful 2BD/1BA/1den Craftsman, nestled in an unrivaled tranquil slow st, w/walking distance to Golden Gate Park, exudes warmth & character w/beautifully preserved architectural details. The sun-filled living room boasts large windows, beautiful hardwood floors, original gorgeous fireplace, & built-ins , offering a perfect blend of vintage charm & modern comfort. The elegant formal dining room boasts classic period details, including charming built-ins. Ideal for both intimate dinners & large gatherings, this space offers a blend of functionality & vintage charm, creating an inviting atmosphere. Step outside onto the deck that invites privacy & relaxation, w/sweeping views of the backyard a serene oasis filled with trees & greenery. A large one-car garage & full basement offers abundant space for parking, storage, art studio, & laundry. Close to many dining/shopping options along Clement, Geary, & 6th Ave. Steps away from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, & Presidio. Public transportation, including 31 Balboa, 38 Geary & 5 Fulton lines are within walking distance. Top-rated schools are just close by. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to one of the most convenient locations SF has to offer!
